decisions.state_note: o000: window near x49–113,y151–215 shows a thick dark lower curve with white below and a narrow white recess above; stroke continues beyond top and side crops. Detector reports horizontal and rising-right bands. Digit unresolved.

o001: window x49–113,y119–183 shows a thick dark band rising right, with a narrow white diagonal region beneath it and more dark below. Both continue through crop edges; detector also reports the rising-right band. Digit unresolved.

o002: window x49–113,y87–151 shows white upper-left and a thick dark band rising right across the lower portion toward x110,y110; dark continues through right crop. Detector supports the diagonal. No complete digit structure yet.

o003: window x81–145,y87–151 shows a broad dark region on the right, a white wedge entering from upper-left, and a narrow white recess entering from below near x111–125. Detector identifies a rising-right band near x99,y130. Overall digit unresolved.

o004: window x81–145,y55–119 shows a thick dark band descending right, separating white upper-right and lower-left regions; it continues through crop boundaries. Detector reports no instances. Upper structure remains unknown.

o005: window x81–145,y23–87 shows a rounded dark upper tip near x115,y47, extending left into a thick curve that bends downward and continues through the bottom crop. White surrounds the tip; detector reports no instances. Digit unresolved.

o006: window x113–177,y23–87 is mostly white, with a rounded dark protrusion at the left near y47 and dark along the lower-right, rising to the right crop near y40. No detector instances; right-side continuation remains unknown.

o007: window x145–209,y23–87 shows a rounded dark upper cap near x187,y44 and a thick shaft descending left through the bottom edge near x161. Detector reports a rising-right band. Lower continuation and overall digit remain unresolved.

o008: window x145–209,y55–119 shows a thick dark diagonal rising right from the left edge near y106 through the top near x185; white lies on both sides. Detector supports this diagonal. Its lower continuation remains unseen.

o009: window x145–209,y87–151 is mostly white; dark occupies the upper-left corner, with a sloping boundary reaching the top near x177 and a narrow dark continuation along the left edge below y110. No detector instances. Lower continuation remains unknown.

o010: window x145–209,y119–183 is white except a narrow dark fragment along the upper-left edge ending near y150; cropping prevents establishing its shape or endpoint. No detector instances. Central and lower structure remain unresolved.

o011: window x113–177,y119–183 shows dark across the upper-left, a small white notch near x118,y135, and a curved right boundary receding left to x113 near y172; lower-right is white. No detector instances. Lower continuation remains unresolved.

o012: window x113–177,y151–215 shows a dark fragment in the upper-left, with a curved boundary reaching the top near x144 and the left edge near y173; the remainder is white. No detector instances. Lower-left structure remains unresolved.

o013: window x81–145,y151–215 shows a dark band across the upper portion, with its lower boundary rising right from about x81,y184 to x144,y151; white below. Detector supports the rising-right band. Left continuation remains cropped.

o014: window x49–113,y151–215 shows a thick dark lower band with a curved lower boundary near y186 and a white recess entering from above around x72–99. Detector reports horizontal and rising-right bands. Left extent remains cropped.

o015: window x17–81,y151–215 shows a rounded dark lower-left bend near x40,y178, extending toward the upper-right crop; white surrounds its left and lower contours, with a small white recess at the right edge near y163. No detector instances. Overall digit remains uncertain.

o016: window x17–81,y119–183 shows white above-left and a dark curved band from the right edge near y132 down-left to x39,y173; a small white recess enters at the right near y163. No detector instances. Central connections remain uncertain.

o017: window x49–113,y119–183 shows a thick dark rising-right band above a narrow white diagonal recess, with dark below; all extend through crop edges. Detector supports the diagonal. Upper-left continuation remains unknown.

o018: window x49–113,y87–151 shows white upper-left and a thick dark band rising right toward x110,y110; a small white area enters below-right. Detector supports the diagonal. Upper-left structure remains unobserved.

o019: window near x49–113,y55–119 shows a dark band descending right from about x80,y70 toward x110,y108, with white to its left; it continues beyond the top and right crops. No detector instances. Central junction remains uncertain.

o020: window x81–145,y55–119 shows a broad dark band descending right between white upper-right and lower-left regions; the upper-right white recess widens toward the top. No detector instances. Central and lower geometry still uncertain.

o021: window x81–145,y87–151 shows a broad dark central region, a white wedge from upper-left, and a narrow white recess from below near x110–125,y130–150. Detector supports a rising-right band near x99,y130. Recess continuation remains uncertain.

o022: window x81–145,y119–183 shows a narrow white diagonal recess between thick dark bands, narrowing to a rounded end near x123,y132; dark continues across the upper and right crops. Detector supports a rising-right band. Lower loop-like structure is suggested; digit remains uncertain.

o023: x81–145,y87–151 shows a white wedge from upper-left, broad dark central/right area, and a narrow white recess entering below near x111–125. Detector reports the same rising-right band. Upper-left bend remains incompletely observed.

o024: x81–145,y55–119 shows a thick dark descending-right band separating white upper-right and lower-left regions; no detector instances. Prior notes suggest a lower loop and two upper tips, making 8 a hypothesis; upper-left turn needs inspection.

o025: rounded upper tip near x115,y47 curves left and downward beyond the crop; white surrounds the tip. No detections. Together with the previously observed lower loop-like recess and upper-right diagonal, the digit is best interpreted as 8.
